This uses actual OPS-SAT observations from [Zenodo v1](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12588359), not synthetic experiment data. Download original `segments.csv` and verify published MD5 `1f4b6ffd0359efac96a6698ff557e0f9` before using the file. Code is not evaluated automatically without data.

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(orbitR)
raw <- read_opssat_segments("data/raw/segments.csv")
print(nrow(raw))
print(segment_summary(raw, raw$channel[1], raw$segment[1]))
```
